name: Cowboy Baby
source:
US wild west. Billy Hickok got into debts and is offered to work as a bouncer at the bar till he repays his debt. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-may-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在美国西部荒野。比利·希科克欠下了一大笔债务。有人向他提议，在偿清欠款之前，可以暂时到酒吧担任保安。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-may-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
